title.narrative: Strengthening Regional Integration: LATINDADD’s Strategic Plan 2022-27

description.narrative:
LATINDADD is a Latin American network composed of civil society organisations with voice, legitimacy and capacity to advocate with other organisations and social movements for alternatives to global financial policies and to build proposals for economic, social and climate justice, to reduce social inequalities and promote systemic transformations with a feminist and peoples' perspective.
Latindadd's vision for 2027 is to consolidate itself as a reference point for social movements and civil society organisations in the region on Tax Justice, New Financial Architecture, Climate Finance, Transformative Economies and Regional Integration. This means: i) strengthening advocacy capacity of its members and allies through regional and global advocacy ii) being a recognised working partner for governments, regional and global organisations and bodies, and iii) ensuring that the allies and actors with whom Latindadd works have tools for advocacy, social coordination and communication on tax justice, new financial architecture, transformative economies and regional integration, linking gender justice with economic justice.
As a consequence, the lines of action for this project are: (i) Organisation and/or participation in processes of reflection, exchange, mobilisation and training on regional integration; (ii) Production of analyses and proposals on regional integration; (iii) Production of communication materials related to regional integration disseminated within the framework of Latindadd's communication strategy. (iv) Organisation of lobbying processes and political dialogue with governments and agencies and integration mechanisms in social and political articulation with various movements, organisations and groups; and (v) Organisation of lobbying and specific social coordination efforts around the proposal for a Social CELAC.
